title: Sarawak recorded the largest 2022–2024 drop in reported absolute poverty: 10.8% to 8.4%, a 2.4 percentage-point decline.
subtitle: Reported absolute household poverty (%); survey observations 1970–2024; changes in percentage points (pp); no price base
notes: 2020 is an estimate and is excluded from survey-to-survey changes.
Early Labuan records without an absolute poverty rate are excluded before computing previous observations.
2016 in this raw file uses the old poverty definition; 2016–2019 change is deliberately null.
Historical definitions and survey coverage change; do not present the full series as one comparable trend.
Null previous values mean first observation; null change at 2019 means definition break.
headline: Sarawak recorded the largest 2022–2024 drop in reported absolute poverty: 10.8% to 8.4%, a 2.4 percentage-point decline. No change crossing the poverty-definition break is reported.
